name: Sedna
description: Read your teams' shared email in Sedna: new messages, tags, job references and contacts.

info.capabilities: Reads your own Sedna teams' messages; changes nothing in Sedna
info.availability: An owner or admin enters the home's Sedna API credentials

credentials.help: An admin of your Sedna organisation makes these on Sedna's API Credential Management page: in Sedna, Settings, then API Credential Management. If Sedna lets you choose what the credential may do, reading is enough for now. If the page isn't there, your Sedna plan may not include the API: ask Sedna's support.
